project.name: Focus Contract Studio
project.summary: A WebMCP-native, human-governed studio that preserves dialog-focus decisions as revisioned precedent, stages unapplied proposals, binds approval to an exact revision, and verifies the resulting live behavior.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT reasons over page-bound WebMCP tools; the application uses no model API. D1-backed RRF retrieves scoped precedent but never authorizes mutation.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported official-source research, implementation, test-driven repairs, security and adversarial review, release preparation, and repository documentation. Exact R10 deployment and supported-client evidence are attached to the public R10 GitHub release. The required video and final Devpost submission are still outstanding.
